data.cancellation_notes: Payment is due at time of booking and sales are final. Customers will receive full credit in case of operator cancellation due to hazardous weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone if your circumstances require re-scheduling charter. Note: Any requests for rescheduling must be done at least 24 hours before your scheduled charter.
data.booking_notes:
Thank you for booking your wedding with Classic Sail Boston! We are thrilled you have chosen us to host your big day. 

We will be available to you for every detail leading up to June 12th, 2026. 

I have already booked your photographer Britt Eddy.  She can be reached directly at  hellobzphoto@gmail.com if you would like to discuss anything with her prior to the wedding. 

Please feel free to reach out to us at Classic Sail by email or phone at anytime. We are here for you to ensure everything meets your expectations. 

Thank you and we look forward to having you aboard!
